transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get the wrap disposition plan locked today so we're ready for Friday's set dismantling after the final stage shoot. As a reminder, the current draft plan sends scenic pieces to a general salvage vendor and places selected hero props in production storage. Before I can approve anything, I need each department lead to confirm their exact disposition and environmental-compliance requirements, and flag any exceptions to the draft plan with the exact corrective requirement so we can get it on the meeting record. Let's start going through department by department.

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception to the draft plan on environmental-compliance grounds. The production's city green-film incentive requires at least 85 percent of dismantled set material by weight to be diverted from landfill. I confirmed with the approved vendor this morning that their audited plan reaches that threshold only through separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record. However, the compliance packet still contains the general-salvage draft, which does not meet this requirement. The exact corrective requirement is: replace the general salvage vendor disposition for scenic pieces with the approved vendor's audited recycling plan using separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record, and update the compliance packet to reflect this before the plan is locked.
